name: cwmenu-language
description: Syntax highlighting, semantic tokens, diagnostics, hover and completions for CWebView CWMenu scripts (.cwm).

cwmenu.diagnostics.unknownKeys.description: Warn about unknown CWMenu element keys.

cwmenu.diagnostics.unknownActions.description: Warn about action names not found in the bundled host-action catalog. App-defined actions are often valid, so this is off by default.
